subject: Onsite demo + SF exec dinner during KubeCon?
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fastscale.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.n@fastscale.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite demo + SF exec dinner during KubeCon?

Hi Alex + Priya,

Hope you’re doing well — excited to lock in plans for the Redwood demo while many of your team will be in SF for KubeCon. We’d love to do an onsite deep-dive with your ML/Infra engineers and host an exec dinner the evening of Wed, Apr 21. High-level asks:

- 2-hour technical demo + integration workshop (we suggest 2:00–4:00pm)
- 30-45m pre-demo sync with your security/infra if you want us to bring audit evidence (SOC 2, data flow, etc.)
- Exec dinner (Redwood + FastScale leadership) Apr 21, 7pm

Proposed window: Tue Apr 20 – Thu Apr 22. Can you share preferred day/time and headcount for dinner (including dietary restrictions)? I’ve attached a draft agenda for the demo.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fastscale.com>

Subject: Re: Onsite demo + SF exec dinner during KubeCon?

Thanks Camila — this sounds great. Our ML infra team (me + Priya) are available Wed Apr 21 in the afternoon; 2–4pm works well for the technical session. For the security pre-sync, looping in security@fastscale.com — they’ll want to review SOC2 and the network topology.

Procurement (cc’d) will need:
- Draft SOW and high-level pricing
- Any standard T&Cs or enterprise addendum

Headcount for exec dinner: 6 total from our side (2 executives + 4 senior managers). Will confirm dietary restrictions once we have a venue.

Also, security asked if you can provide a SOC2 summary and the typical customer data flow diagram ahead of the session.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Lead ML Engineer, FastScale
alex.johnson@fastscale.com

Adding a quick note from the SE side — happy to do a deep-dive on architecture and performance. My availability on Apr 21 is 1:00pm – 5:00pm. I’d propose:

- 11:00am – 11:45am: security/infra pre-sync (network, auth, data flows)
- 2:00pm – 4:00pm: demo + integration workshop (hands-on kernels + inference runtime tuning)
- 4:15pm – 4:45pm: next steps and POC plan

I can bring a pre-configured demo VM and the runbook; please let me know if FastScale will need on-prem images or if we should use our hosted demo environment.

I'll attach the internal runbook and the checklist we run through during onsite demos.

--
Ethan Park

ethan.park@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

- 11:00am – 11:45am: Security/infra pre-sync (security@fastscale.com)
- 2:00pm – 4:00pm: Technical demo + workshop (Redwood SEs + FastScale ML/Infra)
- 7:00pm: Exec dinner (Redwood + FastScale leaders)

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-fastscale-demo-20260421
DocuSign SOW: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC12345

- Alex/Priya: confirm demo VM preference (on-prem vs hosted) and any datasets you want us to bring.
- All: send any dietary restrictions by EOD Tue Apr 13 so we can finalize the dinner reservation.

Thanks everyone — excited to host you.

Hi Camila,

We received the SOW link. For FastScale to proceed we need:
- A copy of Redwood’s standard T&Cs or enterprise addendum for legal review
- A pro-forma invoice for the POC (estimate is fine)
- Clarification on data handling during the POC (we will share an internal dataset)

We will aim to return redlines within 3 business days after the SOW and T&Cs are provided. We do not need a PO to book the dinner; procurement will confirm payment terms for the POC separately.

Thanks,
